parts.label: Attitude, Ethics and Communication (AETCOM)
parts.countCaveats: Row 37 is listed as core and also in the desirable list; rows 16/17 overlap. The 14 additional rows map to existing numbered rows, not new ones.
parts.overlap: Consent, confidentiality and negligence overlap Forensic Medicine rows already in the foundation.
parts.recommendation: First candidate to add if needed: ~54 objectives linked to existing concepts.

parts.countCaveats: Not enumerated in the audit; programme orientation, BLS/first aid, universal precautions, biomedical waste, computer/language/stress-management skills.

parts.label: Early Clinical Exposure (ECE)
parts.countCaveats: A teaching method linking first-year topics to patients; annexure examples are not new requirements.

parts.countCaveats: 47 row appearances are not 47 verified distinct competencies; modules 3.1-3.3 share a parent.
parts.overlap: Outbreak investigation, infection control and sample handling overlap Community Medicine and Microbiology rows.
